title: MARBO: Relational Belief Grounding for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games
abstract: arXiv:2609.06563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Social deduction games (SDGs) require agents to reason under partial observability by maintaining relational beliefs about hidden roles and team alignments. While recent LLM-agent approaches improve gameplay through prompting and preference optimization, they often optimize actions and in-game speech without explicitly grounding them in such beliefs. This frequently leads to strategically inconsistent behavior, especially for compact LLM agents. We introduce Multi-Agent Relational Belief Optimization (MARBO), a belief-grounded preference optimization framework that leverages relational beliefs to guide strategic decisions and in-game speech. MARBO provides preference feedback only when behaviors are supported by reliable relational beliefs and lead to strategically favorable social outcomes, encouraging more consistent learning under uncertainty. translated_title: MARBO：社交推理游戏中LLM智能体的关系信念锚定方法
translated_abstract: 社交推理游戏（SDGs）要求智能体在部分可观测的条件下进行推理，通过维持关于隐藏角色和阵营归属的关系信念。虽然近期的LLM智能体方法通过提示工程和偏好优化提升了游戏表现，但它们通常在没有将行动和游戏内发言显式锚定于此类信念的情况下进行优化。这经常导致策略上不一致的行为，对于紧凑型LLM智能体尤其如此。我们提出了多智能体关系信念优化（MARBO），这是一个信念锚定的偏好优化框架，利用关系信念来指导战略决策和游戏内发言。MARBO仅在行为得到可靠关系信念支持并带来策略上有利的社会结果时才提供偏好反馈，从而鼓励在不确定性下进行更一致的学习。在代表性社交推理游戏上的实验表明，MARBO使紧凑型LLM智能体能够持续地……
tldr: 提出MARBO框架，将关系信念锚定到偏好优化中，仅在行为有可靠信念支持且产生有利社会结果时给予偏好反馈，使紧凑型LLM智能体在社交推理游戏中实现策略一致的行为。
en_tdlr: MARBO is a belief-grounded preference optimization framework that provides preference feedback only when behaviors are supported by reliable relational beliefs and lead to strategically favorable social outcomes, enabling compact LLM agents to behave consistently in social deduction games.
